The NSW Government is seeking community feedback on the draft National Parks Establishment Plan (the draft plan).

National parks play an important role in conserving biodiversity and protecting cultural heritage across NSW.

The draft plan updates the current National Parks Establishment Plan (2008), providing a clear framework for growing the national park estate to protect NSW's unique natural and cultural heritage for future generations. This includes how land will be assessed and prioritised for future investment.

Abu Dhabi launches major training programme to teach AI skills | The National

AiNative initiative will equip citizens, residents and government employees with vital tech skills

Actual Article Body:
UAE

October 07, 2026

Abu Dhabi aims to become the world's first AI-native government by 2027, underpinned by a $3.5 billion digital infrastructure investment.
The AiNative programme will equip 20,000 government employees with AI skills by year's end, focusing on tools including ChatGPT and Microsoft 365 Copilot.
Citizens and residents can access free AI training through the Tomouh app, covering personal finance, job-seeking, small business management and responsible content creation.
The initiative is a collaboration between Abu Dhabi's government, OpenAI, Microsoft and Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence, with the curriculum owned by the Department of Government Enablement.
"AI will only create lasting value when people have the knowledge and confidence to use it well," said the director general of GovDigital at the Department of Government Enablement.
